test.$inputsComment: nx.json's test inputs, plus what the business-app generators' specs run as commands or read, which nothing in the project graph links to this project: the package pipeline and its helpers, the app definition's validator, the Payers kit's exported model, the vehicle kit's hand-written checklist schema and model, which app-model's spec writes again, and the layout designer's JSON writer, which src/util/json-file-text.ts copies. Without them an edit to any of them would replay a cached pass.

lint.$comment: @nx/eslint/plugin infers a target named `eslint:lint`, which `nx affected -t lint` does NOT match — so neither the gate nor CI ever linted this project. An `nx.targets` block in package.json is not read for a package.json-inferred project, so the target is declared here instead.
